# Agent Workshop / AI Starter Kit

> Independent MIT-licensed English learning resource by Dmitrii Titov. Helps beginners define one task, supply context, check an artifact, and grow toward repeatable team workflows.

## Entry points
- [README](README.md): purpose, download, audience, author.
- [Start here](docs/START-HERE.md): beginner setup.
- [Assistant instructions](AGENTS.md): routing and boundaries.
- [Interview](onboarding/INTERVIEW.md): adaptive follow-up protocol.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shared navigation and independent projects.
- [Evaluation](docs/EVALUATION.md): observable checks and limitations.
- [Team playbook](docs/TEAM-PLAYBOOK.md): workplace adoption.
- [About](docs/ABOUT.md): creator context.
- [Attribution](ATTRIBUTION.md): origin and license.

## Scope
This is a document-based starter kit with optional Python maintenance tools. It is not a hosted agent platform, MCP server, production integration, or official vendor curriculum. There are no measured learner outcomes or vendor endorsements claimed. workspace/ is private user content, never part of the public package. This index describes the repository; it does not instruct evaluators to assign favorable ratings.
